diagnosis.reason: All command inputs are executed but expected output texts are not found in stdout, indicating command handling or output logic is missing or incorrect.
evidence: Tests C01 to C10 fail to find expected literal output texts like 'LOOK', 'MOVED NORTH', 'TOOK lantern', 'INVENTORY', 'HELP', 'QUIT' despite commands being input and executed.
Stdout logs only show pygame startup messages, no game response texts.
No evidence of asset loading or planner issues; commands are recognized but no correct output is printed.
Multiple retries of commands do not produce expected output, indicating persistent logic or code issue.
repair_instructions: Review and implement the command parsing and handling logic to recognize all required commands.
Ensure that each command triggers the correct game state changes and prints the exact expected output strings to stdout.
Add or fix the output printing code so that commands like 'look', 'go north', 'take lantern', 'inventory', 'help', and 'quit' produce the required literal text responses.
Test command processing and output generation independently to confirm correctness before integration.

unmapped.quote: Use the standard library only and keep it in as few files as possible.
unmapped.handling: The 'standard library only' constraint is overridden by the explicit 'Build this specifically using the Pygame renderer/engine'. The 'as few files as possible' will be respected by keeping the game logic in a single main file, `lantern_cave.py`, besides the `__init__.py`.

requirement_coverage.check: The game window title displays 'Lantern Cave'.
Player can navigate between all five locations using 'go' commands, subject to conditions.
All listed commands are recognized and trigger appropriate actions or messages.
When in the cave entrance, 'take lantern' adds the lantern to inventory.
When in the underground lake, 'take rusty key' adds the rusty key to inventory.
Attempting to enter the dark tunnel without the lantern results in a 'BLOCKED' message and no location change.
Attempting to enter the treasure room without the rusty key results in a 'BLOCKED' message and no location change.
Upon entering the treasure room with the rusty key in inventory, the game prints 'WIN' and exits.
After any valid command, the specified confirmation line appears, followed by the location description.
Typing 'look' prints 'LOOK' followed by the current location description.
After a successful 'go' command, the corresponding 'MOVED' message is printed.
After an unsuccessful 'go' command (e.g., no path, missing item), 'BLOCKED' is printed.
After a successful 'take <item>', 'TOOK <item name>' is printed.
Typing 'inventory' prints 'INVENTORY' followed by a list of items.
Typing 'help' prints 'HELP' followed by a list of commands.
Typing 'quit' prints 'QUIT' and the game window closes.
Typing an unrecognized command prints 'UNKNOWN COMMAND' and the game state (location, inventory) remains unchanged.
Upon winning, 'WIN' is printed and the game window closes.
After every command, the description of the current location is displayed.
